name: v0.3.48 — Quick-launch strip in the bottom bar + restored feature pills
releaseNotes:
• New quick-launch strip in the bottom bar — Steals, Rewards, Stash, Inbox and Miles are now one tap away from any screen, with horizontal scroll.
• Dashboard: the original horizontal feature-pill scroll is back (Worth It?, Guacanomics, GuacWizard, Steals, Rewards, Stash, Inbox, Car Miles).
• Sign-out confirm button is now slim.
• Steals stays in-app with the full web experience.
